cause.what_happened: LONA gapped up 4% and then fell about 34% intraday to $3.41 by the 15:04 ET screen on 8.5x volume, with no 8-K, press release or third-party filing dated 2026-09-23 to 09-25 found. The nearest documented driver is the funding cliff: the FDA approved Lilly's imlunestrant plus abemaciclib on 2026-09-18, which is a direct competitor to ELAINE-3's lasofoxifene plus abemaciclib and is also the trigger that made the $6.35 Series A warrants exercisable for about 30 days, disclosed in the 8-K filed after the close on 2026-09-22. With the stock well below $6.35, that $146.2m looks unlikely to be exercised.

outside_window.finding: The $146.2m Series A cash exercise at $6.35 lapses around 2026-10-19 with the stock far below the strike. Absent an inducement or repricing, the company's main funding bridge fails while the 10-Q already carries going-concern language and S-3 is barred through December 2026. Expect a financing, an inducement (dilutive) or strategic action on a later date. Undated inside the window.

Overhang: PIPE investors (Commodore, Perceptive, TCGX and others) hold resale-registered shares and pre-funded warrants bought at $6.35. With the Series A optionality now out of the money, they have less reason to hold. This seller is unfinished and undated.
ELAINE-3 (NCT05696626) enrollment completion is expected in Q4 2026 and topline in 2H 2027. It now competes against an approved imlunestrant plus abemaciclib label in the same population.
Q3 2026 10-Q/earnings will show cash of roughly $30-35m against a fully diluted market value near cash. The date is only the Zacks estimate of 2026-11-05, which is not company-announced.
